```{r}
alumni <- read.csv("~/Desktop/BANA 7052/alumni.csv")

# Question 1a

# Fit simple linear regression
fit <- lm(alumni_giving_rate ~ percent_of_classes_under_20, data = alumni)

# Extract slope estimate and standard error
b1    <- coef(fit)[2]
se_b1 <- summary(fit)$coefficients[2, 2]

# Rebuild the t-statistic manually
t_stat <- b1 / se_b1

# Extract p-value
p_value <- summary(fit)$coefficients[2, 4]

# Print results
b1
se_b1
t_stat
p_value

# Question 1b

# Test whether the slope differs from 1
t_stat_1 <- (b1 - 1) / se_b1
t_stat_1

# Two-sided p-value for H0: beta1 = 1
p_value_1 <- 2 * pt(abs(t_stat_1), df = nrow(alumni) - 2, lower.tail = FALSE)
p_value_1


# Question 1c
summary(fit)$r.squared


# Question 1d

# 95% confidence interval for mean giving rate at X = 50
predict(fit,
        newdata = data.frame(percent_of_classes_under_20 = 50),
        interval = "confidence",
        level = 0.95)

# 95% prediction interval for one university at X = 50
predict(fit,
        newdata = data.frame(percent_of_classes_under_20 = 50),
        interval = "prediction",
        level = 0.95)

# Question 1e

# Fit model
fit <- lm(alumni_giving_rate ~ percent_of_classes_under_20, data = alumni)

# Create sequence of X values for smooth confidence band
x_seq <- seq(min(alumni$percent_of_classes_under_20),
             max(alumni$percent_of_classes_under_20),
             length.out = 200)

# Get confidence band
conf_band <- predict(fit,
                     newdata = data.frame(percent_of_classes_under_20 = x_seq),
                     interval = "confidence")

# Plot training data
plot(alumni$percent_of_classes_under_20, alumni$alumni_giving_rate,
     pch = 19, col = "darkblue",
     xlab = "Percent of Classes Under 20",
     ylab = "Alumni Giving Rate",
     main = "Regression Line with 95% Confidence Band")

# Add fitted regression line
abline(fit, col = "red", lwd = 2)

# Add confidence band
lines(x_seq, conf_band[, "lwr"], col = "orange", lwd = 2, lty = 2)
lines(x_seq, conf_band[, "upr"], col = "orange", lwd = 2, lty = 2)

# Add the point (X̄, Ȳ)
points(mean(alumni$percent_of_classes_under_20),
       mean(alumni$alumni_giving_rate),
       pch = 19, col = "purple", cex = 2)

# Question 1f

anova(fit)

# Question 2b
set.seed(7052)

n <- 100
x <- rnorm(n, mean = 2, sd = 0.1)
eps <- rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = 0.5)
y <- 10 + 5*x + eps

fit <- lm(y ~ x)
summary(fit)

# Question 2c
set.seed(7052)

n <- 100
x <- rnorm(n, mean = 2, sd = 0.1)
eps2 <- rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = 1)   # sigma = 1 now

y2 <- 10 + 5*x + eps2

fit2 <- lm(y2 ~ x)
summary(fit2)

# MSE:
mse2 <- mean(fit2$residuals^2)
mse2

# Question 3a

set.seed(7052)
n <- 100
draws <- replicate(1000, {
  x <- rnorm(n, mean = 2, sd = 0.1)
  y <- 10 + 5 * x + rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = 0.5)
  fit <- lm(y ~ x)
  rss <- sum(residuals(fit)^2)
  c(b1 = unname(coef(fit)[2]),   # estimated slope
    mse = rss / (n - 2),         # MSE
    mle = rss / n)               # maximum-likelihood estimate
})

mean(draws["b1", ])
sd(draws["b1", ])

# Question 3b
set.seed(7052)
n <- 400
draws <- replicate(1000, {
  x <- rnorm(n, mean = 2, sd = 0.1)
  y <- 10 + 5 * x + rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = 0.5)
  fit <- lm(y ~ x)
  rss <- sum(residuals(fit)^2)
  c(b1 = unname(coef(fit)[2]),
    mse = rss / (n - 2),
    mle = rss / n)
})

mean(draws["b1", ])
sd(draws["b1", ])
```
